    About Us

    Built on the Ground, Not on Screens

    Tarkar Cricket Academy is an offline cricket academy at Kalindi Kunj, Jaisinghpura, Vrindavan Road, Mathura. Young players train together in white kit, in the open air, under qualified coaches who care about technique, fitness and character.

    From first-time kids to serious match players, every session is structured, supervised and focused on steady improvement.

    What We Teach

    Complete Cricket Training

    01

    Batting

    Stance, grip, footwork and shot selection for every situation.

    02

    Bowling

    Pace and spin basics, line and length, run-up and action.

    03

    Fielding & Keeping

    Catching, ground fielding, throwing and wicket-keeping drills.

    04

    Fitness

    Strength, stamina and agility built for the demands of the game.

    05

    Match Play

    Practice matches that build confidence, tactics and temperament.

    Our Mentors

    Guided by Experience

    Our coaches are on the field every session, correcting technique, setting drills and leading by example. Every player gets attention, whether they are learning the basics or preparing for tournaments.
